# Assets

`banner.png` is the hero image at the top of the README. `social.png` is the repository's social
preview, set in repository settings, which is what renders when the link is shared.

Neither is generated by a script in this folder, and there is no template. Each one is written as a
prose description of the image wanted, given to an image model, judged, and rewritten until it is
right. The description for this repository lives with the build notes, not here.
